seo.title: Marta Easy — Atlanta Transit App for iOS
seo.description: Marta Easy shows next departures, delay status, and service alerts for MARTA in a clean at-a-glance interface. Built for daily commuters who care about reliable, no-frills information.

hero.label: Atlanta Transit App
hero.title: Check your commute before you leave the house.
text: Marta Easy shows next departures, delay status, and service alerts for MARTA in a clean at-a-glance interface. Built for daily commuters who care about reliable, no-frills information.

items.title: Transit at a glance
items.text: See departures, direction, and estimated arrival time from your favorite MARTA stops before you open the app.

items.title: Status and reliability
items.text: Track delay and suspension updates in one list so your plan can adjust around real-time conditions.

items.title: Leave-at guidance
items.text: The app suggests when to head out based on the departures you care about, helping you leave on time more often.

items.title: Offline fallback
items.text: When connectivity drops, cached schedules and recent data still help you make an informed commute decision.

items.title: Clean onboarding
items.text: No accounts, no sign up, no hidden setup. Choose your stops and you can be using it immediately.

sections.title: Privacy
text: Marta Easy does not collect personal profiles or analytics. Your usage stays on-device and no ads drive the app experience. Transit and status data is sourced from public MARTA feeds as designed by the service.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Install Marta Easy to track smarter and stay focused on what matters.
